must_cover: light-dependent reactions generate ATP and reduced NADP
the Calvin cycle fixes carbon using those products
rate is limited by the factor in shortest supply

lessons.title: Chloroplast structure and function
lessons.objective: Relate the internal structure of a chloroplast to the two stages it houses.
must_establish: thylakoid membranes host the light-dependent stage

lessons.title: Pigments and wavelength
lessons.objective: Explain why a plant appears green given which wavelengths its pigments absorb.

lessons.title: Electron transport
lessons.objective: Explain how excited electrons move along the electron transport chain and what replaces them.
must_establish: photolysis of water replaces lost electrons
oxygen is a by-product of photolysis

lessons.title: ATP synthesis by chemiosmosis
lessons.objective: Explain how a proton gradient across the thylakoid membrane drives ATP synthesis.
must_establish: ATP synthase couples proton flow to ATP formation

lessons.title: Fixing carbon dioxide
lessons.objective: Explain how carbon dioxide is fixed onto RuBP to produce GP.

lessons.title: Reduction and regeneration
lessons.objective: Explain how ATP and reduced NADP convert GP to TP and regenerate RuBP.
must_establish: the cycle consumes the products of the light-dependent stage
RuBP must be regenerated for the cycle to continue

lessons.title: Limiting factors
lessons.objective: Predict how photosynthetic rate responds when light, carbon dioxide or temperature is varied.
must_establish: rate is limited by the factor in shortest supply
